---
title: "`r paste(params$label, 'export review')`"
params:
  db_path: ""
  label: "export"
  units_rds: ""
  alignments: true
output:
  html_document:
    toc: true
    toc_float: true
    self_contained: true
    theme: flatly
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
# Reach the package internals the same way whether RiboPilot is installed or
# loaded with devtools::load_all().
rp <- asNamespace("RiboPilot")
con <- rp$open_project_db(params$db_path)
units <- readRDS(params$units_rds)
smry <- rp$export_summary_df(con, units)
```

```{css, echo=FALSE}
svg { max-width: 100%; height: auto; }
.feature-map { border-top: 1px solid #eee; padding-top: 0.4em; margin: 1.2em 0; }
```

Group **`r params$label`** &middot; `r nrow(units)` unit(s) &middot; generated
`r format(Sys.time(), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M")`.

## Summary

```{r summary-table}
cols <- intersect(c("seqid", "ID", "organism", "length", "n_features", "missing",
  "reviewed", "partial", "variant_class", "submission_risk", "chimera_warning"), names(smry))
knitr::kable(smry[, cols, drop = FALSE], row.names = FALSE)
```

## Per-sample feature maps

```{r feature-maps, results='asis'}
maps <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(units)), function(i) {
  htmltools::HTML(rp$feature_map_svg(con, units$ID[i], units$path[i],
    units$scaffold[i], units$seqid[i]))
})
src <- unlist(lapply(seq_len(nrow(units)), function(i) {
  org <- smry$organism[i]
  c(sprintf("### %s", units$seqid[i]), "",
    if (!is.na(org) && nzchar(org)) c(sprintf("*%s*", org), ""),
    sprintf("```{r fmap-%d, echo=FALSE}\nmaps[[%d]]\n```", i, i), "")
}))
cat(knitr::knit_child(text = src, quiet = TRUE), sep = "\n")
```

```{r alignments, results='asis', eval=isTRUE(params$alignments)}
cat("## Feature alignments\n\n")
elements <- rp$report_elements(con, units)
alns <- list()
src <- character(0)
for (el in elements) {
  seqs <- rp$gather_feature_seqs(con, units, el)
  res <- rp$feature_alignment(seqs)
  src <- c(src, sprintf("### %s", el), "")
  if (is.null(res)) {
    src <- c(src, sprintf("*Annotated in %d unit(s); at least 2 are needed to align.*",
      length(seqs)), "")
    next
  }
  alns[[el]] <- msaR::msaR(res$alignment, menu = FALSE, overviewbox = FALSE,
    seqlogo = FALSE, labelNameLength = 160)
  pid <- if (is.na(res$mean_identity)) "n/a" else sprintf("%.1f%%", res$mean_identity)
  len <- if (res$min_len == res$max_len) {
    sprintf("%d bp", res$min_len)
  } else {
    sprintf("%d-%d bp", res$min_len, res$max_len)
  }
  src <- c(src, sprintf("%d units aligned, %s, mean identity %s.", res$n, len, pid), "",
    sprintf("```{r aln-%s, echo=FALSE}\nalns[[%s]]\n```",
      gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]", "", el), deparse(el)), "")
}
if (length(elements) == 0) src <- c(src, "*No annotated features in this group.*", "")
cat(knitr::knit_child(text = src, quiet = TRUE), sep = "\n")
```

```{r teardown, include=FALSE}
DBI::dbDisconnect(con)
```
